summary: VersaBank filed a Form 6-K on April 29, 2026, announcing the start of a pilot program for its AI-enabled Real-Time Structured Receivable Program with partner FinanceIt Canada Inc. This is a routine business update regarding an operational enhancement to the bank's point-of-sale financing product, not a special situation. No transactional event, shareholder action, or structural change is involved. The press release describes a gradual rollout and market expansion but provides no financial terms, board recommendation, advisors, or regulatory timetable. This filing is a standard operational announcement that does not trigger any special-situations classification.
